notes.title: Update
notes.content: Hello munchers! We apologize for the silence over the past couple years. With major changes to the engine we were using and life events, we have been unable to do much work on "The After Levels". We are currently strategizing on the best way forward. We deeply appreciate your patience, understanding and support!

notes.title: Free Content Update coming soon!
notes.content:
[b]Hello Munchers![/b]
To show my appreciate for all of you, there will be a free content update for Earth Muncher!! There will be plenty more levels, some new baddies, new obstacles, and treasures that await Norm. 

Stay tuned for more info!

notes.title: Special Announcement: Earth Day 2018
notes.content:
[h1]What better way to celebrate the Earth than to Nom it?[/h1]

I am pleased to announce that 20% of all sales release week will be donated to the Earth Day Network!
